Geschossflächenzahl (GFZ): Geschossflächenzahl (GFZ): represents the ratio of the total floor area of all building stories to the plot area. It controls the horizontal spread of buildings.
Grundflächenzahl (GRZ): Grundflächenzahl (GRZ): represents the proportion of the plot area that can be covered by buildings. It controls the vertical density (i.e., the total built-up floor area).
Erdgeschossfußbodenoberkante (EG FOK): Erdgeschossfußbodenoberkante (EG FOK): refers to the level of the top edge of the finished floor of the ground floor.
Fußbodenoberkante (FOK): Fußbodenoberkante (FOK): refers to the top edge of the finished floor of any story in the building.
